قَوْلٌ حَلِىٌّ A saying sweet in the mouth. (K.) ―
-b2- نَاقَةٌ حَلِيَّةٌ (Lh, M, K) and ↓ حَلُوَّةٌ , (K,) the latter is the original form [but app. obsolete], (Lh, M,) A she-camel eminent, (Lh, M,) or perfect, (K,) in pleasingness, or goodliness, or beauty: (Lh, M, K:) or pleasing in appearance and pace. (TA in art. علو.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
